name: Microgrid restoration stabilization hold
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Maintains the defined stage while its specified electrical stabilization conditions are assessed.
description: Maintains the defined stage while its specified electrical stabilization conditions are assessed. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Stage measurements and timing” at the input and “Stage progression restraint” at the output. A time delay alone does not establish stability.
